blurb: Bicycles & Boats is a multigenerational family-run business offering bike and paddlesports rentals, shuttle and delivery services. They provide standard, electric, and kids bikes, as well as kayaks, paddleboards, and canoes. Their base is in Hill City, South Dakota, operating seasonally from June 1st to Labor Day Monday, with limited hours after Labor Day until the first weekend of October.
